dialogue.text: The Bremen Town Musicians, shout out to Christian for suggesting today's tale.
dialogue.zh: 不來梅的音樂家，感謝Christian建議今天的故事。
dialogue.ja: ブレーメンの音楽隊、今日のお話を提案してくれたクリスチャンに感謝します。
dialogue.local: The Bremen Town Musicians, shout out to Christian for suggesting today's tale.
dialogue.en: The Bremen Town Musicians, shout out to Christian for suggesting today's tale.

dialogue.text: You've become useless with age. Perhaps it's time I fed you to the wolves.
dialogue.zh: 你年紀大了變得沒用了，也許該把你餵給狼了。
dialogue.ja: 年を取って役に立たなくなったな。そろそろ狼に食べられてもらおうか。
dialogue.local: You've become useless with age. Perhaps it's time I fed you to the wolves.
dialogue.en: You've become useless with age. Perhaps it's time I fed you to the wolves.

dialogue.text: Move!
dialogue.ja: 動け！
dialogue.local: Move!
dialogue.en: Move!

dialogue.text: Worthless!
dialogue.ja: 役立たず！
dialogue.local: Worthless!
dialogue.en: Worthless!

dialogue.text: Ah, music! They have musicians in Bremen.
dialogue.zh: 啊，音樂！不來梅有音樂家。
dialogue.ja: ああ、音楽だ！ブレーメンには音楽家がいるんだな。
dialogue.local: Ah, music! They have musicians in Bremen.
dialogue.en: Ah, music! They have musicians in Bremen.

dialogue.text: If they don't need an old worker, maybe Bremen needs a new musician.
dialogue.zh: 如果他們不需要老工人，也許不來梅需要新的音樂家。
dialogue.ja: もし彼らが年老いた労働者を必要としないなら、ブレーメンは新しい音楽家を必要としているのかもしれない。
dialogue.local: If they don't need an old worker, maybe Bremen needs a new musician.
dialogue.en: If they don't need an old worker, maybe Bremen needs a new musician.

dialogue.text: Bremen Town, here I come.
dialogue.ja: ブレーメンの町よ、今行くぞ。
dialogue.local: Bremen Town, here I come.
dialogue.en: Bremen Town, here I come.

dialogue.text: Good morning. You look as though you've raced the wind and lost.
dialogue.zh: 早安。你看起來像是和風賽跑卻輸了。
dialogue.ja: おはよう。風と競争して負けたみたいだね。
dialogue.local: Good morning. You look as though you've raced the wind and lost.
dialogue.en: Good morning. You look as though you've raced the wind and lost.

dialogue.text: Feels more like the wind outran me.
dialogue.zh: 感覺更像是風跑得比我快。
dialogue.ja: 風に置いていかれた感じだよ。
dialogue.local: Feels more like the wind outran me.
dialogue.en: Feels more like the wind outran me.

dialogue.text: What happened?
dialogue.ja: どうしたんだ？
dialogue.local: What happened?
dialogue.en: What happened?

dialogue.text: I was a hunting dog.
dialogue.ja: 私はかつて猟犬だった。
dialogue.local: I was a hunting dog.
dialogue.en: I was a hunting dog.

dialogue.text: The best. Once. No fox escaped me.
dialogue.zh: 曾經是最棒的。沒有狐狸能逃過我。
dialogue.ja: かつては最高だった。キツネは一匹も逃げられなかった。
dialogue.local: The best. Once. No fox escaped me.
dialogue.en: The best. Once. No fox escaped me.

dialogue.text: No rabbit outran me. No deer slipped past my nose.
dialogue.zh: 沒有兔子跑得比我快，沒有鹿能從我鼻子旁溜走。
dialogue.ja: ウサギも私に追いつけなかった。シカも鼻先をかすめて逃げられなかった。
dialogue.local: No rabbit outran me. No deer slipped past my nose.
dialogue.en: No rabbit outran me. No deer slipped past my nose.

dialogue.text: But today my legs couldn't keep up. The hunter called me useless.
dialogue.zh: 但今天我的腿跟不上了，獵人說我沒用了。
dialogue.ja: でも今日は足がついていけなかった。猟師は私を役立たずと呼んだ。
dialogue.local: But today my legs couldn't keep up. The hunter called me useless.
dialogue.en: But today my legs couldn't keep up. The hunter called me useless.

dialogue.text: He said I'd only slow the younger dogs. I heard him say he wouldn't be feeding me much longer.
dialogue.zh: 他說我只會拖慢年輕的狗，我聽到他說不會再餵我了。
dialogue.ja: 若い犬たちの足を引っ張るだけだと言われた。もう長くは餌をやらないとも聞いた。
dialogue.local: He said I'd only slow the younger dogs. I heard him say he wouldn't be feeding me much longer.
dialogue.en: He said I'd only slow the younger dogs. I heard him say he wouldn't be feeding me much longer.

dialogue.text: So, I left before he could decide my fate.
dialogue.zh: 所以我在他決定我的命運前離開了。
dialogue.ja: だから、彼が私の運命を決める前に去ったんだ。
dialogue.local: So, I left before he could decide my fate.
dialogue.en: So, I left before he could decide my fate.

dialogue.text: Then we're alike.
dialogue.ja: じゃあ、私たちは似ているね。
dialogue.local: Then we're alike.
dialogue.en: Then we're alike.

dialogue.text: You two?
dialogue.ja: 君たち二人？
dialogue.local: You two?
dialogue.en: You two?

dialogue.text: Yesterday I was a hard working farm donkey. Today?
dialogue.zh: 昨天我還是勤勞的農場驢子，今天呢？
dialogue.ja: 昨日までは一生懸命働く農場のロバだった。今日は？
dialogue.local: Yesterday I was a hard working farm donkey. Today?
dialogue.en: Yesterday I was a hard working farm donkey. Today?

dialogue.text: I'm apparently yesterday's news.
dialogue.ja: 私はもう時代遅れのようだ。
dialogue.local: I'm apparently yesterday's news.
dialogue.en: I'm apparently yesterday's news.

dialogue.text: I'm on my way to Bremen.
dialogue.ja: 私はブレーメンへ向かっている。
dialogue.local: I'm on my way to Bremen.
dialogue.en: I'm on my way to Bremen.

dialogue.text: Bremen, what waits for you there?
dialogue.zh: 不來梅，等著你的會是什麼？
dialogue.ja: ブレーメンには何が待っているんだ？
dialogue.local: Bremen, what waits for you there?
dialogue.en: Bremen, what waits for you there?

dialogue.text: A new career. I'm going to be a town musician.
dialogue.zh: 一個新職業，我要成為城鎮音樂家。
dialogue.ja: 新しい職業だ。町の音楽家になるんだ。
dialogue.local: A new career. I'm going to be a town musician.
dialogue.en: A new career. I'm going to be a town musician.

dialogue.text: You're serious?
dialogue.ja: 本気か？
dialogue.local: You're serious?
dialogue.en: You're serious?

dialogue.text: Completely. I have a voice.
dialogue.ja: もちろんだ。声がある。
dialogue.local: Completely. I have a voice.
dialogue.en: Completely. I have a voice.

dialogue.text: And I have a mighty bar.
dialogue.zh: 我還有強而有力的吠聲。
dialogue.ja: そして強力な吠え声も持っている。
dialogue.local: And I have a mighty bar.
dialogue.en: And I have a mighty bar.

dialogue.text: Together, we'll make twice the music.
dialogue.zh: 我們一起會創造雙倍的音樂。
dialogue.ja: 一緒に、二倍の音楽を作ろう。
dialogue.local: Together, we'll make twice the music.
dialogue.en: Together, we'll make twice the music.

dialogue.text: I'm not sure people would pay to hear me bark.
dialogue.zh: 我不確定人們會付錢聽我吠。
dialogue.ja: 人が私の吠え声にお金を払うとは思えないな。
dialogue.local: I'm not sure people would pay to hear me bark.
dialogue.en: I'm not sure people would pay to hear me bark.

dialogue.text: Perhaps not, but they'll certainly remember us.
dialogue.zh: 也許不會，但他們肯定會記得我們。
dialogue.ja: たぶんそうじゃないけど、きっと私たちのことは忘れないよ。
dialogue.local: Perhaps not, but they'll certainly remember us.
dialogue.en: Perhaps not, but they'll certainly remember us.

dialogue.text: You really don't mind traveling with an old dog?
dialogue.zh: 你真的不介意和一隻老狗一起旅行？
dialogue.ja: 本当に年老いた犬と旅をしても気にしないのか？
dialogue.local: You really don't mind traveling with an old dog?
dialogue.en: You really don't mind traveling with an old dog?

dialogue.text: Not at all. The road is much shorter with a friend.
dialogue.zh: 一點也不，有朋友路程會短很多。
dialogue.ja: 全然気にしない。友達がいれば道はずっと短く感じる。
dialogue.local: Not at all. The road is much shorter with a friend.
dialogue.en: Not at all. The road is much shorter with a friend.

dialogue.text: Then I'd be honored to join your orchestra.
dialogue.zh: 那我很榮幸加入你們的樂團。
dialogue.ja: それなら、君たちのオーケストラに参加できて光栄だ。
dialogue.local: Then I'd be honored to join your orchestra.
dialogue.en: Then I'd be honored to join your orchestra.

dialogue.text: Excellent! Our audience won't know what hit them.
dialogue.zh: 太好了！我們的觀眾會措手不及。
dialogue.ja: 素晴らしい！観客は何が起きたかわからないだろう。
dialogue.local: Excellent! Our audience won't know what hit them.
dialogue.en: Excellent! Our audience won't know what hit them.

dialogue.text: Mm-hmm, mm-hmm, mm-hmm.
dialogue.ja: うんうん、うんうん、うんうん。
dialogue.local: Mm-hmm, mm-hmm, mm-hmm.
dialogue.en: Mm-hmm, mm-hmm, mm-hmm.

dialogue.text: And!
dialogue.ja: そして！
dialogue.local: And!
dialogue.en: And!

dialogue.text: Good afternoon. That's the saddest meow I've ever heard.
dialogue.zh: 下午好。那是我聽過最悲傷的喵聲。
dialogue.ja: こんにちは。今まで聞いた中で一番悲しいニャーだね。
dialogue.local: Good afternoon. That's the saddest meow I've ever heard.
dialogue.en: Good afternoon. That's the saddest meow I've ever heard.

dialogue.text: It's been that kind of day.
dialogue.ja: そんな一日だったんだ。
dialogue.local: It's been that kind of day.
dialogue.en: It's been that kind of day.

dialogue.text: What's happened?
dialogue.ja: 何があったの？
dialogue.local: What's happened?
dialogue.en: What's happened?

dialogue.text: The farmer said that I am too old and that he has no use for me anymore.
dialogue.zh: 農夫說我太老了，不再需要我。
dialogue.ja: 農夫は私が年を取りすぎてもう役に立たないと言った。
dialogue.local: The farmer said that I am too old and that he has no use for me anymore.
dialogue.en: The farmer said that I am too old and that he has no use for me anymore.

dialogue.text: I spent my whole life protecting that house.
dialogue.zh: 我一生都在守護那棟房子。
dialogue.ja: 私は一生その家を守ってきた。
dialogue.local: I spent my whole life protecting that house.
dialogue.en: I spent my whole life protecting that house.

dialogue.text: Now my paws aren't as quick.
dialogue.zh: 現在我的爪子不再靈活。
dialogue.ja: 今はもう足が速くない。
dialogue.local: Now my paws aren't as quick.
dialogue.en: Now my paws aren't as quick.

dialogue.text: And suddenly I've become a burden.
dialogue.ja: そして突然、私は重荷になった。
dialogue.local: And suddenly I've become a burden.
dialogue.en: And suddenly I've become a burden.

dialogue.text: Sounds familiar.
dialogue.ja: 聞き覚えがあるな。
dialogue.local: Sounds familiar.
dialogue.en: Sounds familiar.

dialogue.text: You too?
dialogue.ja: 君もか？
dialogue.local: You too?
dialogue.en: You too?

dialogue.text: Yes.
dialogue.ja: はい。
dialogue.local: Yes.
dialogue.en: Yes.

dialogue.text: Then I suppose we're members of the same unfortunate club.
dialogue.zh: 那我想我們是同一個不幸俱樂部的成員。
dialogue.ja: じゃあ、私たちは同じ不運なクラブの仲間だな。
dialogue.local: Then I suppose we're members of the same unfortunate club.
dialogue.en: Then I suppose we're members of the same unfortunate club.

dialogue.text: Perhaps, but we've started a much better one.
dialogue.zh: 也許，但我們開始了一個更好的俱樂部。
dialogue.ja: そうかもしれないけど、私たちはもっと良いクラブを始めたよ。
dialogue.local: Perhaps, but we've started a much better one.
dialogue.en: Perhaps, but we've started a much better one.

dialogue.text: Oh?
dialogue.ja: おや？
dialogue.local: Oh?
dialogue.en: Oh?

dialogue.text: We're traveling to Bremen to become town musicians.
dialogue.zh: 我們正前往不來梅成為城鎮音樂家。
dialogue.ja: 私たちはブレーメンへ町の音楽家になるために旅をしている。
dialogue.local: We're traveling to Bremen to become town musicians.
dialogue.en: We're traveling to Bremen to become town musicians.

dialogue.text: You're serious?
dialogue.ja: 本気なのか？
dialogue.local: You're serious?
dialogue.en: You're serious?

dialogue.text: Completely serious.
dialogue.ja: 本気だよ。
dialogue.local: Completely serious.
dialogue.en: Completely serious.

dialogue.text: Questionable talent? Excellent enthusiasm.
dialogue.ja: 才能は疑わしい？でも熱意は素晴らしい。
dialogue.local: Questionable talent? Excellent enthusiasm.
dialogue.en: Questionable talent? Excellent enthusiasm.

dialogue.text: I'm afraid my singing mostly happens at night.
dialogue.zh: 恐怕我大多在晚上唱歌。
dialogue.ja: 私の歌は主に夜にしか起きないんだ。
dialogue.local: I'm afraid my singing mostly happens at night.
dialogue.en: I'm afraid my singing mostly happens at night.

dialogue.text: People usually throw boots at me.
dialogue.zh: 人們通常會朝我丟靴子。
dialogue.ja: 人々はたいてい私に靴を投げる。
dialogue.local: People usually throw boots at me.
dialogue.en: People usually throw boots at me.

dialogue.text: Then they'll definitely remember your performance.
dialogue.zh: 那他們肯定會記得你的表演。
dialogue.ja: なら、きっと君のパフォーマンスは忘れられないだろう。
dialogue.local: Then they'll definitely remember your performance.
dialogue.en: Then they'll definitely remember your performance.

dialogue.text: Besides, every orchestra needs variety.
dialogue.zh: 而且，每個樂團都需要多樣性。
dialogue.ja: それに、どんなオーケストラにも多様性が必要だ。
dialogue.local: Besides, every orchestra needs variety.
dialogue.en: Besides, every orchestra needs variety.

dialogue.text: Perhaps it's time I stop chasing mice.
dialogue.zh: 也許是時候停止抓老鼠了。
dialogue.ja: そろそろネズミを追いかけるのはやめる時かもしれない。
dialogue.local: Perhaps it's time I stop chasing mice.
dialogue.en: Perhaps it's time I stop chasing mice.

dialogue.text: Very well.
dialogue.ja: いいだろう。
dialogue.local: Very well.
dialogue.en: Very well.

dialogue.text: Where does a future star performer stand?
dialogue.zh: 未來的明星表演者站在哪裡？
dialogue.ja: 未来のスターはどこに立つ？
dialogue.local: Where does a future star performer stand?
dialogue.en: Where does a future star performer stand?

dialogue.text: Right beside her fellow musicians.
dialogue.zh: 就在她的音樂夥伴旁邊。
dialogue.ja: 仲間の音楽家のすぐそばに立つ。
dialogue.local: Right beside her fellow musicians.
dialogue.en: Right beside her fellow musicians.

dialogue.text: Welcome to the finest orchestra that doesn't exist yet.
dialogue.zh: 歡迎來到尚未存在的最棒樂團。
dialogue.ja: まだ存在しない最高のオーケストラへようこそ。
dialogue.local: Welcome to the finest orchestra that doesn't exist yet.
dialogue.en: Welcome to the finest orchestra that doesn't exist yet.

dialogue.text: That's quite a voice.
dialogue.ja: なかなかの声だね。
dialogue.local: That's quite a voice.
dialogue.en: That's quite a voice.

dialogue.text: Why does it sound like you're announcing the end of the world?
dialogue.zh: 為什麼聽起來像是在宣告世界末日？
dialogue.ja: なぜ世界の終わりを告げているように聞こえるんだ？
dialogue.local: Why does it sound like you're announcing the end of the world?
dialogue.en: Why does it sound like you're announcing the end of the world?

dialogue.text: Because for me, it is.
dialogue.zh: 因為對我來說，真的是如此。
dialogue.ja: 私にとっては、本当にそうなんだ。
dialogue.local: Because for me, it is.
dialogue.en: Because for me, it is.

dialogue.text: What do you mean?
dialogue.ja: どういう意味だ？
dialogue.local: What do you mean?
dialogue.en: What do you mean?

dialogue.text: I've greeted every sunrise on this farm.
dialogue.zh: 我在這農場迎接過每個日出。
dialogue.ja: この農場で毎朝日の出を迎えてきた。
dialogue.local: I've greeted every sunrise on this farm.
dialogue.en: I've greeted every sunrise on this farm.

dialogue.text: Tomorrow will be my last.
dialogue.zh: 明天將是我的最後一天。
dialogue.ja: 明日が最後になるだろう。
dialogue.local: Tomorrow will be my last.
dialogue.en: Tomorrow will be my last.

dialogue.text: The farmer plans to have me for dinner.
dialogue.ja: 農夫は私を夕食にしようとしている。
dialogue.local: The farmer plans to have me for dinner.
dialogue.en: The farmer plans to have me for dinner.

dialogue.text: You don't have to stay.
dialogue.ja: ここにいなくてもいいんだ。
dialogue.local: You don't have to stay.
dialogue.en: You don't have to stay.

dialogue.text: Where would I go?
dialogue.ja: どこへ行けばいい？
dialogue.local: Where would I go?
dialogue.en: Where would I go?

dialogue.text: This place is all I've ever known.
dialogue.zh: 這裡是我唯一熟悉的地方。
dialogue.ja: ここが私の知っているすべての場所だ。
dialogue.local: This place is all I've ever known.
dialogue.en: This place is all I've ever known.

dialogue.text: That's exactly what I thought about my stable.
dialogue.zh: 我對我的馬廄也是這麼想的。
dialogue.ja: 私も自分の厩舎についてそう思っていた。
dialogue.local: That's exactly what I thought about my stable.
dialogue.en: That's exactly what I thought about my stable.

dialogue.text: And I thought my hunting trail was my whole world.
dialogue.zh: 我以為我的獵場就是我的全世界。
dialogue.ja: そして私は狩猟の道が自分の全世界だと思っていた。
dialogue.local: And I thought my hunting trail was my whole world.
dialogue.en: And I thought my hunting trail was my whole world.

dialogue.text: I couldn't imagine life beyond my farmhouse.
dialogue.zh: 我無法想像農舍外的生活。
dialogue.ja: 農場の外の生活なんて想像できなかった。
dialogue.local: I couldn't imagine life beyond my farmhouse.
dialogue.en: I couldn't imagine life beyond my farmhouse.

dialogue.text: Where are you all going?
dialogue.ja: みんなはどこへ行くんだ？
dialogue.local: Where are you all going?
dialogue.en: Where are you all going?

dialogue.text: To Braman.
dialogue.ja: ブレーメンへ。
dialogue.local: To Braman.
dialogue.en: To Braman.

dialogue.text: We're starting a musical group.
dialogue.zh: 我們要組成一個音樂團體。
dialogue.ja: 音楽グループを始めるんだ。
dialogue.local: We're starting a musical group.
dialogue.en: We're starting a musical group.

dialogue.text: A donkey, a dog, and a cat.
dialogue.zh: 一隻驢、一隻狗和一隻貓。
dialogue.ja: ロバと犬と猫だ。
dialogue.local: A donkey, a dog, and a cat.
dialogue.en: A donkey, a dog, and a cat.

dialogue.text: We've been told our performances are unforgettable.
dialogue.zh: 有人說我們的表演令人難忘。
dialogue.ja: 私たちの演奏は忘れられないと言われている。
dialogue.local: We've been told our performances are unforgettable.
dialogue.en: We've been told our performances are unforgettable.

dialogue.text: Mostly by people begging us to stop.
dialogue.zh: 大多是人們求我們停止。
dialogue.ja: ほとんどはやめてくれと懇願する人たちだ。
dialogue.local: Mostly by people begging us to stop.
dialogue.en: Mostly by people begging us to stop.

dialogue.text: You have the finest voice among us.
dialogue.zh: 你是我們中聲音最好的。
dialogue.ja: 君は私たちの中で一番いい声を持っている。
dialogue.local: You have the finest voice among us.
dialogue.en: You have the finest voice among us.

dialogue.text: You wake the whole countryside every morning.
dialogue.zh: 你每天早上吵醒整個鄉村。
dialogue.ja: 毎朝君は村中を起こしている。
dialogue.local: You wake the whole countryside every morning.
dialogue.en: You wake the whole countryside every morning.

dialogue.text: Imagine what you could do on a stage.
dialogue.zh: 想像你在舞台上能做什麼。
dialogue.ja: 舞台の上で何ができるか想像してみて。
dialogue.local: Imagine what you could do on a stage.
dialogue.en: Imagine what you could do on a stage.

dialogue.text: If I'm going to sing,
dialogue.ja: もし歌うなら、
dialogue.local: If I'm going to sing,
dialogue.en: If I'm going to sing,

dialogue.text: I'd rather sing for applause than for someone's supper.
dialogue.zh: 我寧願為掌聲唱歌，也不願為晚餐唱歌。
dialogue.ja: 誰かの夕食のためより拍手のために歌いたい。
dialogue.local: I'd rather sing for applause than for someone's supper.
dialogue.en: I'd rather sing for applause than for someone's supper.

dialogue.text: Then come with us.
dialogue.ja: それなら私たちと一緒に来なよ。
dialogue.local: Then come with us.
dialogue.en: Then come with us.

dialogue.text: Welcome to the Braman Town Musicians.
dialogue.zh: 歡迎來到不來梅城鎮音樂家。
dialogue.ja: ブレーメンの町の音楽隊へようこそ。
dialogue.local: Welcome to the Braman Town Musicians.
dialogue.en: Welcome to the Braman Town Musicians.

dialogue.text: We don't even have any songs yet.
dialogue.zh: 我們甚至還沒有任何歌曲。
dialogue.ja: まだ曲は一つもないけどね。
dialogue.local: We don't even have any songs yet.
dialogue.en: We don't even have any songs yet.

dialogue.text: No, but we have a full band.
dialogue.zh: 沒有，但我們有完整的樂隊。
dialogue.ja: ないけど、フルバンドはあるよ。
dialogue.local: No, but we have a full band.
dialogue.en: No, but we have a full band.

dialogue.text: What do you suppose Braman is really like?
dialogue.zh: 你覺得不來梅到底是什麼樣子？
dialogue.ja: ブレーメンは本当はどんなところだと思う？
dialogue.local: What do you suppose Braman is really like?
dialogue.en: What do you suppose Braman is really like?

dialogue.text: I imagine streets filled with music.
dialogue.ja: 音楽であふれた通りを想像するよ。
dialogue.local: I imagine streets filled with music.
dialogue.en: I imagine streets filled with music.

dialogue.text: People smiling.
dialogue.ja: 人々が笑顔でいる。
dialogue.local: People smiling.
dialogue.en: People smiling.

dialogue.text: No one asking how old you are.
dialogue.ja: 年齢を聞かれない。
dialogue.local: No one asking how old you are.
dialogue.en: No one asking how old you are.

dialogue.text: I'd settle for a warm fire and a full supper every evening.
dialogue.zh: 我願意每天晚上有溫暖的火爐和豐盛的晚餐。
dialogue.ja: 毎晩暖かい火と満腹の夕食があれば十分だ。
dialogue.local: I'd settle for a warm fire and a full supper every evening.
dialogue.en: I'd settle for a warm fire and a full supper every evening.

dialogue.text: And a soft cushion by the window.
dialogue.ja: そして窓辺の柔らかいクッション。
dialogue.local: And a soft cushion by the window.
dialogue.en: And a soft cushion by the window.

dialogue.text: One that's actually meant for sleeping.
dialogue.ja: 本当に寝るためのものだ。
dialogue.local: One that's actually meant for sleeping.
dialogue.en: One that's actually meant for sleeping.

dialogue.text: I want crowds cheering every morning instead of telling me to be quiet.
dialogue.zh: 我想要每天早上群眾歡呼，而不是叫我安靜。
dialogue.ja: 毎朝歓声を浴びたい、静かにしろと言われる代わりに。
dialogue.local: I want crowds cheering every morning instead of telling me to be quiet.
dialogue.en: I want crowds cheering every morning instead of telling me to be quiet.

dialogue.text: Funny, isn't it?
dialogue.ja: 面白いだろう？
dialogue.local: Funny, isn't it?
dialogue.en: Funny, isn't it?

dialogue.text: Yesterday, we were all alone.
dialogue.ja: 昨日はみんな一人ぼっちだった。
dialogue.local: Yesterday, we were all alone.
dialogue.en: Yesterday, we were all alone.

dialogue.text: Today, we're a band.
dialogue.ja: 今日は私たちはバンドだ。
dialogue.local: Today, we're a band.
dialogue.en: Today, we're a band.

dialogue.text: And somehow the road doesn't seem nearly as long.
dialogue.zh: 而且路程似乎不再那麼遙遠。
dialogue.ja: そしてなぜか道のりがずっと短く感じる。
dialogue.local: And somehow the road doesn't seem nearly as long.
dialogue.en: And somehow the road doesn't seem nearly as long.

dialogue.text: That's because we're walking it together.
dialogue.ja: それは一緒に歩いているからだ。
dialogue.local: That's because we're walking it together.
dialogue.en: That's because we're walking it together.

dialogue.text: Shall we rehearse?
dialogue.ja: リハーサルしようか？
dialogue.local: Shall we rehearse?
dialogue.en: Shall we rehearse?

dialogue.text: Why not?
dialogue.ja: いいよ。
dialogue.local: Why not?
dialogue.en: Why not?

dialogue.text: Meow!
dialogue.ja: ニャー！
dialogue.local: Meow!
dialogue.en: Meow!

dialogue.text: Meow!
dialogue.ja: ニャー！
dialogue.local: Meow!
dialogue.en: Meow!

dialogue.text: Look, a light.
dialogue.ja: 見て、光がある。
dialogue.local: Look, a light.
dialogue.en: Look, a light.

dialogue.text: Do you smell that?
dialogue.ja: 匂いがする？
dialogue.local: Do you smell that?
dialogue.en: Do you smell that?

dialogue.text: Roasted meat.
dialogue.ja: 焼き肉だ。
dialogue.local: Roasted meat.
dialogue.en: Roasted meat.

dialogue.text: Fresh bread?
dialogue.ja: 焼きたてのパン？
dialogue.local: Fresh bread?
dialogue.en: Fresh bread?

dialogue.text: Come on.
dialogue.ja: 行こう。
dialogue.local: Come on.
dialogue.en: Come on.

dialogue.text: Let's see who lives there.
dialogue.zh: 我們去看看誰住在那裡。
dialogue.ja: 誰が住んでいるか見てみよう。
dialogue.local: Let's see who lives there.
dialogue.en: Let's see who lives there.

dialogue.text: I smell butter.
dialogue.ja: バターの匂いがする。
dialogue.local: I smell butter.
dialogue.en: I smell butter.

dialogue.text: Real butter.
dialogue.ja: 本物のバターだ。
dialogue.local: Real butter.
dialogue.en: Real butter.

dialogue.text: I've been thinking about supper for the last three miles.
dialogue.zh: 我已經想著晚餐走了三英里。
dialogue.ja: ここ3マイルずっと夕食のことを考えていた。
dialogue.local: I've been thinking about supper for the last three miles.
dialogue.en: I've been thinking about supper for the last three miles.

dialogue.text: Everyone, climb aboard.
dialogue.ja: みんな、乗って。
dialogue.local: Everyone, climb aboard.
dialogue.en: Everyone, climb aboard.

dialogue.text: To another successful robbery.
dialogue.ja: また一つ成功した強盗だ。
dialogue.local: To another successful robbery.
dialogue.en: To another successful robbery.

dialogue.text: That may be the finest meal I've ever seen.
dialogue.zh: 那可能是我見過最棒的一餐。
dialogue.ja: 今まで見た中で最高の食事かもしれない。
dialogue.local: That may be the finest meal I've ever seen.
dialogue.en: That may be the finest meal I've ever seen.

dialogue.text: And certainly the worst company.
dialogue.zh: 而且肯定是最糟的同伴。
dialogue.ja: そして間違いなく最悪の仲間だ。
dialogue.local: And certainly the worst company.
dialogue.en: And certainly the worst company.

dialogue.text: Perhaps those robbers won't be dining alone for much longer.
dialogue.zh: 也許那些強盜不會再孤單用餐了。
dialogue.ja: あの強盗たちはもうすぐ一人で食事をしなくなるかもしれない。
dialogue.local: Perhaps those robbers won't be dining alone for much longer.
dialogue.en: Perhaps those robbers won't be dining alone for much longer.

dialogue.text: The door is too strong.
dialogue.ja: ドアが強すぎる。
dialogue.local: The door is too strong.
dialogue.en: The door is too strong.

dialogue.text: We'd never get through it.
dialogue.ja: 通り抜けられない。
dialogue.local: We'd never get through it.
dialogue.en: We'd never get through it.

dialogue.text: And if we try, they'll chase us away before we reach the table.
dialogue.zh: 如果我們嘗試，他們會在我們到桌子前趕走我們。
dialogue.ja: もし試みたら、テーブルに着く前に追い払われるだろう。
dialogue.local: And if we try, they'll chase us away before we reach the table.
dialogue.en: And if we try, they'll chase us away before we reach the table.

dialogue.text: Unless they run away instead.
dialogue.ja: 彼らが代わりに逃げるなら別だけど。
dialogue.local: Unless they run away instead.
dialogue.en: Unless they run away instead.

dialogue.text: How?
dialogue.ja: どうやって？
dialogue.local: How?
dialogue.en: How?

dialogue.text: We've spent days worrying about becoming musicians.
dialogue.zh: 我們花了好幾天擔心成為音樂家。
dialogue.ja: 私たちは何日も音楽家になることを心配してきた。
dialogue.local: We've spent days worrying about becoming musicians.
dialogue.en: We've spent days worrying about becoming musicians.

dialogue.text: Perhaps our music can save us tonight.
dialogue.zh: 也許今晚我們的音樂能救我們。
dialogue.ja: もしかしたら今夜、私たちの音楽が助けてくれるかもしれない。
dialogue.local: Perhaps our music can save us tonight.
dialogue.en: Perhaps our music can save us tonight.

dialogue.text: Everyone, climb aboard.
dialogue.ja: みんな、乗って。
dialogue.local: Everyone, climb aboard.
dialogue.en: Everyone, climb aboard.

dialogue.text: Steady?
dialogue.ja: しっかり？
dialogue.local: Steady?
dialogue.en: Steady?

dialogue.text: Steady?
dialogue.ja: しっかり？
dialogue.local: Steady?
dialogue.en: Steady?

dialogue.text: Please don't look.
dialogue.ja: 見ないでください。
dialogue.local: Please don't look.
dialogue.en: Please don't look.

dialogue.text: Please don't look down.
dialogue.ja: 下を見ないでください。
dialogue.local: Please don't look down.
dialogue.en: Please don't look down.

dialogue.text: I'm trying not to.
dialogue.ja: 見ないようにしている。
dialogue.local: I'm trying not to.
dialogue.en: I'm trying not to.

dialogue.text: Remember, sing like your life depends on it.
dialogue.zh: 記住，唱得像你的生命依賴它一樣。
dialogue.ja: 命がけで歌うんだ。
dialogue.local: Remember, sing like your life depends on it.
dialogue.en: Remember, sing like your life depends on it.

dialogue.text: Because it does.
dialogue.ja: そうしなければならないからだ。
dialogue.local: Because it does.
dialogue.en: Because it does.

dialogue.text: Three.
dialogue.ja: 三、
dialogue.local: Three.
dialogue.en: Three.

dialogue.text: Two.
dialogue.ja: 二、
dialogue.local: Two.
dialogue.en: Two.

dialogue.text: One.
dialogue.ja: 一、
dialogue.local: One.
dialogue.en: One.

dialogue.text: He-haw!
dialogue.ja: ヒーハー！
dialogue.local: He-haw!
dialogue.en: He-haw!

dialogue.ja: ヒーハー！
dialogue.local: He-haw!
dialogue.en: He-haw!

dialogue.en: He-haw!

dialogue.local: He-haw!

dialogue.local: He-haw!
dialogue.en: He-haw!

dialogue.text: He-haw!
dialogue.ja: ヒーハー！
dialogue.local: He-haw!
dialogue.en: He-haw!

dialogue.text: Monsters!
dialogue.ja: 怪物だ！
dialogue.local: Monsters!
dialogue.en: Monsters!

dialogue.text: It's a forest demon!
dialogue.ja: 森の悪魔だ！
dialogue.local: It's a forest demon!
dialogue.en: It's a forest demon!

dialogue.text: Run!
dialogue.ja: 逃げろ！
dialogue.local: Run!
dialogue.en: Run!

dialogue.text: Ow!
dialogue.ja: 痛っ！
dialogue.local: Ow!
dialogue.en: Ow!

dialogue.text: I'd say our first concert was a success.
dialogue.zh: 我想說我們的首次演奏會很成功。
dialogue.ja: 最初のコンサートは成功だったと言えるね。
dialogue.local: I'd say our first concert was a success.
dialogue.en: I'd say our first concert was a success.

dialogue.text: And we even earned our supper.
dialogue.ja: しかも夕食も手に入れた。
dialogue.local: And we even earned our supper.
dialogue.en: And we even earned our supper.

dialogue.text: Woo-hoo!
dialogue.ja: やったー！
dialogue.local: Woo-hoo!
dialogue.en: Woo-hoo!

dialogue.text: May I suggest that we don't let all this wonderful food go to waste?
dialogue.zh: 我建議我們不要浪費這些美味的食物。
dialogue.ja: この素晴らしい食べ物を無駄にしないようにしよう。
dialogue.local: May I suggest that we don't let all this wonderful food go to waste?
dialogue.en: May I suggest that we don't let all this wonderful food go to waste?

dialogue.text: I second the motion.
dialogue.ja: 賛成だ。
dialogue.local: I second the motion.
dialogue.en: I second the motion.

dialogue.text: Mm-hmm.
dialogue.ja: うんうん。
dialogue.local: Mm-hmm.
dialogue.en: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.text: Mm-hmm.
dialogue.ja: うんうん。
dialogue.local: Mm-hmm.
dialogue.en: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.ja: うんうん。
dialogue.local: Mm-hmm.
dialogue.en: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.ja: うんうん。
dialogue.local: Mm-hmm.
dialogue.en: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.ja: うんうん。
dialogue.local: Mm-hmm.
dialogue.en: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.ja: うんうん。
dialogue.local: Mm-hmm.
dialogue.en: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.ja: うんうん。
dialogue.local: Mm-hmm.
dialogue.en: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.ja: うんうん。
dialogue.local: Mm-hmm.
dialogue.en: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.text: Mm-hmm.
dialogue.ja: うんうん。
dialogue.local: Mm-hmm.
dialogue.en: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.text: That was the finest meal of my life.
dialogue.zh: 那是我一生中最棒的一餐。
dialogue.ja: 人生で最高の食事だった。
dialogue.local: That was the finest meal of my life.
dialogue.en: That was the finest meal of my life.

dialogue.text: And the finest dining companions.
dialogue.ja: そして最高の食事仲間だ。
dialogue.local: And the finest dining companions.
dialogue.en: And the finest dining companions.

dialogue.text: I'll keep watch, just in case our audience returns.
dialogue.zh: 我會守夜，以防觀眾回來。
dialogue.ja: 見張りをしておくよ、観客が戻ってくるかもしれないから。
dialogue.local: I'll keep watch, just in case our audience returns.
dialogue.en: I'll keep watch, just in case our audience returns.

dialogue.text: Mm-hmm.
dialogue.ja: うんうん。
dialogue.local: Mm-hmm.
dialogue.en: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.text: Mm-hmm.
dialogue.ja: うんうん。
dialogue.local: Mm-hmm.
dialogue.en: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.text: We're not leaving all our treasure behind because of one bad scare.
dialogue.zh: 我們不會因為一次驚嚇就放棄所有寶藏。
dialogue.ja: 一度の恐怖で宝物を全部置いていくわけにはいかない。
dialogue.local: We're not leaving all our treasure behind because of one bad scare.
dialogue.en: We're not leaving all our treasure behind because of one bad scare.

dialogue.text: Mm-hmm.
dialogue.ja: うんうん。
dialogue.local: Mm-hmm.
dialogue.en: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.text: Go inside and see what's really there.
dialogue.zh: 進去看看裡面到底是什麼。
dialogue.ja: 中に入って本当の様子を見てみよう。
dialogue.local: Go inside and see what's really there.
dialogue.en: Go inside and see what's really there.

dialogue.text: Why me?
dialogue.ja: なぜ私？
dialogue.local: Why me?
dialogue.en: Why me?

dialogue.text: Because you're the fastest.
dialogue.ja: 君が一番速いからだ。
dialogue.local: Because you're the fastest.
dialogue.en: Because you're the fastest.

dialogue.text: If anything chases you, run!
dialogue.zh: 如果有什麼東西追你，就跑！
dialogue.ja: 何かに追われたら、逃げろ！
dialogue.local: If anything chases you, run!
dialogue.en: If anything chases you, run!

dialogue.text: Just an empty house.
dialogue.ja: ただの空き家だ。
dialogue.local: Just an empty house.
dialogue.en: Just an empty house.

dialogue.text: What happened?
dialogue.ja: 何があった？
dialogue.local: What happened?
dialogue.en: What happened?

dialogue.text: It's cursed.
dialogue.ja: 呪われているんだ。
dialogue.local: It's cursed.
dialogue.en: It's cursed.

dialogue.text: There's a wicked witch by the fire who clawed my face.
dialogue.zh: 火旁有個邪惡的女巫抓傷了我的臉。
dialogue.ja: 火のそばにいる悪い魔女が私の顔を引っかいた。
dialogue.local: There's a wicked witch by the fire who clawed my face.
dialogue.en: There's a wicked witch by the fire who clawed my face.

dialogue.text: Oh!
dialogue.ja: ああ！
dialogue.local: Oh!
dialogue.en: Oh!

dialogue.text: A giant soldier with a knife bit my leg.
dialogue.zh: 一個拿刀的巨人士兵咬了我的腿。
dialogue.ja: ナイフを持った巨大な兵士が私の脚を噛んだ。
dialogue.local: A giant soldier with a knife bit my leg.
dialogue.en: A giant soldier with a knife bit my leg.

dialogue.text: A monstrous horse kicked me into the yard.
dialogue.zh: 一匹怪物馬踢我到院子裡。
dialogue.ja: 怪物のような馬が私を庭に蹴り飛ばした。
dialogue.local: A monstrous horse kicked me into the yard.
dialogue.en: A monstrous horse kicked me into the yard.

dialogue.text: And on the roof, a terrible judge shouted, catch that thief!
dialogue.zh: 屋頂上，一個可怕的法官大喊，抓住那個小偷！
dialogue.ja: 屋根の上で恐ろしい裁判官が叫んだ、「あの泥棒を捕まえろ！」と。
dialogue.local: And on the roof, a terrible judge shouted, catch that thief!
dialogue.en: And on the roof, a terrible judge shouted, catch that thief!

dialogue.text: Whoa!
dialogue.ja: うわっ！
dialogue.local: Whoa!
dialogue.en: Whoa!

dialogue.text: The treasure isn't worth it.
dialogue.ja: 宝物は価値がない。
dialogue.local: The treasure isn't worth it.
dialogue.en: The treasure isn't worth it.

dialogue.text: We can always steal another treasure if we're alive.
dialogue.zh: 只要活著，我們總能偷到另一個寶藏。
dialogue.ja: 生きていればまた別の宝物を盗める。
dialogue.local: We can always steal another treasure if we're alive.
dialogue.en: We can always steal another treasure if we're alive.

dialogue.text: Let's go and never return.
dialogue.ja: 行こう、二度と戻らないように。
dialogue.local: Let's go and never return.
dialogue.en: Let's go and never return.

dialogue.text: Now that's the kind of wake-up call I enjoy.
dialogue.zh: 這才是我喜歡的驚醒方式。
dialogue.ja: これこそ私が好きな目覚めの合図だ。
dialogue.local: Now that's the kind of wake-up call I enjoy.
dialogue.en: Now that's the kind of wake-up call I enjoy.

dialogue.text: Should we keep going?
dialogue.ja: 続けるべきかな？
dialogue.local: Should we keep going?
dialogue.en: Should we keep going?

dialogue.text: Why?
dialogue.ja: なぜ？
dialogue.local: Why?
dialogue.en: Why?

dialogue.text: We set out looking for a place where we belonged.
dialogue.zh: 我們出發尋找屬於我們的地方。
dialogue.ja: 私たちは自分の居場所を探しに出かけた。
dialogue.local: We set out looking for a place where we belonged.
dialogue.en: We set out looking for a place where we belonged.

dialogue.text: I think we've already found it.
dialogue.ja: もう見つけたと思う。
dialogue.local: I think we've already found it.
dialogue.en: I think we've already found it.

dialogue.text: A safe home.
dialogue.ja: 安全な家。
dialogue.local: A safe home.
dialogue.en: A safe home.

dialogue.text: Good friends.
dialogue.ja: 良い友達。
dialogue.local: Good friends.
dialogue.en: Good friends.

dialogue.text: Plenty of food.
dialogue.ja: たくさんの食べ物。
dialogue.local: Plenty of food.
dialogue.en: Plenty of food.

dialogue.text: Hmm.
dialogue.ja: うん。
dialogue.local: Hmm.
dialogue.en: Hmm.

dialogue.text: I'd call that success.
dialogue.ja: それを成功と呼ぼう。
dialogue.local: I'd call that success.
dialogue.en: I'd call that success.

dialogue.text: And no one here cares how old we are.
dialogue.zh: 這裡沒有人在乎我們多老。
dialogue.ja: ここでは誰も年齢を気にしない。
dialogue.local: And no one here cares how old we are.
dialogue.en: And no one here cares how old we are.

dialogue.text: Perhaps Bramin wasn't the destination after all.
dialogue.zh: 也許不來梅根本不是目的地。
dialogue.ja: もしかするとブレーメンは目的地じゃなかったのかもしれない。
dialogue.local: Perhaps Bramin wasn't the destination after all.
dialogue.en: Perhaps Bramin wasn't the destination after all.

dialogue.text: Perhaps it was the reason we found each other.
dialogue.zh: 也許它是我們找到彼此的原因。
dialogue.ja: それは私たちが出会った理由だったのかもしれない。
dialogue.local: Perhaps it was the reason we found each other.
dialogue.en: Perhaps it was the reason we found each other.

dialogue.text: Well then.
dialogue.ja: それなら。
dialogue.local: Well then.
dialogue.en: Well then.

dialogue.text: The Bramin town musicians without Bramin.
dialogue.zh: 沒有不來梅的不來梅城鎮音樂家。
dialogue.ja: ブレーメンなしのブレーメンの町の音楽隊。
dialogue.local: The Bramin town musicians without Bramin.
dialogue.en: The Bramin town musicians without Bramin.

dialogue.text: Turns out all they needed was each other.
dialogue.ja: 結局彼らに必要だったのはお互いだけだった。
dialogue.local: Turns out all they needed was each other.
dialogue.en: Turns out all they needed was each other.

dialogue.text: I walked away with the weary heart.
dialogue.zh: 我帶著疲憊的心離開了。
dialogue.ja: 疲れた心で歩き去った。
dialogue.local: I walked away with the weary heart.
dialogue.en: I walked away with the weary heart.

dialogue.text: Thinking my whole life had fallen apart.
dialogue.zh: 以為我的一生已經崩潰。
dialogue.ja: 人生が崩れたと思った。
dialogue.local: Thinking my whole life had fallen apart.
dialogue.en: Thinking my whole life had fallen apart.

dialogue.text: But every road can lead somewhere new.
dialogue.zh: 但每條路都能通往新地方。
dialogue.ja: でもどの道も新しい場所へ続く。
dialogue.local: But every road can lead somewhere new.
dialogue.en: But every road can lead somewhere new.

dialogue.text: When hope decides to walk with you.
dialogue.ja: 希望が君と共に歩むとき。
dialogue.local: When hope decides to walk with you.
dialogue.en: When hope decides to walk with you.

dialogue.text: I wish you for a year after you.
dialogue.ja: 君の後の一年を願う。
dialogue.local: I wish you for a year after you.
dialogue.en: I wish you for a year after you.

dialogue.text: Till my whole life filled up with fear.
dialogue.ja: 私の人生が恐怖で満たされるまで。
dialogue.local: Till my whole life filled up with fear.
